name: Exp_VWAP_Close
summary: This EA trades based on the VWAP_Close custom indicator, generating buy signals when VWAP values are rising (trend up) and sell signals when VWAP values are falling (trend down). It uses configurable money management modes, fixed stop loss and take profit levels, and processes signals on new bar formation to avoid redundant trades. The strategy is a systematic trend-following approach that enters in the direction of the VWAP momentum.
summary_zh: 该EA基于VWAP_Close自定义指标进行交易，当VWAP值上升时产生买入信号，VWAP值下降时产生卖出信号。它支持可配置的资金管理模式、固定止损止盈水平，并在新K线形成时处理信号以避免重复交易。这是一个系统化的趋势跟踪策略，沿VWAP动量方向入场。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于VWAP（成交量加权平均价格）指标的趋势跟踪。入场条件：当Value[1]<Value[2]（VWAP从下降转为上升或持续下降但趋缓）且Value[0]>Value[1]（当前值大于前一根值，即VWAP上升），产生买入信号；当Value[1]>Value[2]（VWAP从上升转为下降）且Value[0]<Value[1]（当前值小于前一根值，即VWAP下降），产生卖出信号。出场条件通过反向信号触发平仓，同时设置了固定的止损（1000点）和止盈（2000点）进行风险管理。仓位管理支持五种模式：按可用保证金比例、按余额比例、按扣除浮亏后的保证金比例、按扣除浮亏后的余额比例、固定手数。信号处理采用新K线检测机制，避免同一根K线上重复入场。指标使用3个缓冲区值进行比较，SignalBar参数控制从哪根K线开始读取数据。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is trend following based on the VWAP (Volume Weighted Average Price) indicator. Entry conditions: when Value[1]<Value[2] (VWAP declining or bottoming) and Value[0]>Value[1] (current VWAP rising above previous), a buy signal is generated; when Value[1]>Value[2] (VWAP rising or topping) and Value[0]<Value[1] (current VWAP falling below previous), a sell signal is generated. Exit conditions are triggered by opposing signals for position closure, combined with fixed stop loss (1000 points) and take profit (2000 points) for risk management. Position sizing supports five modes: percentage of free margin, percentage of balance, percentage of free margin minus floating loss, percentage of balance minus floating loss, and fixed lot size. Signal processing uses a new bar detection mechanism to prevent repeated entries on the same bar. The indicator reads 3 buffer values for comparison, and the SignalBar parameter controls which bar to start reading data from, allowing signal offset configuration.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 资金管理参数，控制仓位大小比例或固定手数
parameters.description_en: Money management parameter controlling lot size ratio or fixed lot

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 仓位计算模式：可用保证金/余额/扣除浮亏后保证金/扣除浮亏后余额/固定手数
parameters.description_en: Lot mode: free margin / balance / margin minus floating loss / balance minus floating loss / fixed lot

parameters.name: BuyPosClose
parameters.description: 是否允许买入平仓（平多单）

parameters.name: SellPosClose
parameters.description: 是否允许卖出平仓（平空单）

parameters.name: VolumeType
parameters.description: 成交量类型：跳价成交量或真实成交量
parameters.description_en: Volume type: tick volume or real volume

pros: 使用VWAP指标结合成交量分析，信号比普通均线更具市场代表性
提供五种仓位管理模式，灵活适应不同风险偏好
新K线检测机制避免同一根K线上重复交易，减少过度交易风险
止损止盈比例1:2，具有正期望收益的盈亏比设计
可通过BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen等参数灵活控制交易方向
pros_en: Uses VWAP indicator incorporating volume analysis, providing more market-representative signals than simple moving averages
Offers five position sizing modes for flexible risk preference adaptation
New bar detection mechanism prevents redundant trades on the same bar, reducing overtrading risk
Stop loss to take profit ratio of 1:2 provides a positive expectancy reward-to-risk design
Flexible control over trading directions via BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen and close parameters
cons: 止损1000点和止盈2000点数值偏大，在低波动品种上可能导致持仓时间过长
没有扩散过滤器，在高扩散时段交易可能造成不利成交
依赖外部自定义指标VWAP_Close和TradeAlgorithms.mqh库，部署时需要确保这些文件可用
信号逻辑仅基于三个VWAP值的简单比较，缺乏额外的趋势确认或过滤机制
没有移动止损或保本止损功能，盈利单可能大幅回撤后才触发止盈或反转平仓
cons_en: Stop loss of 1000 points and take profit of 2000 points are large values that may result in excessively long holding periods on low-volatility instruments
No spread filter, trading during high-spread periods may result in unfavorable fills
Depends on external custom indicator VWAP_Close and TradeAlgorithms.mqh library, requiring these files to be available for deployment
Signal logic relies solely on simple comparison of three VWAP values, lacking additional trend confirmation or filtering mechanisms
No trailing stop or break-even functionality, profitable positions may retrace significantly before hitting take profit or triggering reversal close
improvements: 增加扩散过滤器，在点差过大时暂停开仓，避免不利成交
添加移动止损或保本止损功能，在盈利达到一定比例后锁定利润
增加额外的趋势确认指标（如ATR过滤、更大周期趋势判断），减少震荡行情中的假信号
improvements_en: Add a spread filter to pause opening positions when spread is excessively wide, avoiding unfavorable fills
Implement trailing stop or break-even functionality to lock in profits after reaching a certain gain threshold
Add additional trend confirmation indicators (e.g., ATR filter, higher timeframe trend assessment) to reduce false signals in ranging markets

risk_points: 止损止盈固定点数不适应不同品种的波动性，低波动品种止损过大而高波动品种止损可能不足
没有扩散过滤和最大持仓检查，极端行情下可能造成较大损失
VWAP指标依赖自定义文件，若文件缺失EA将初始化失败但不会造成交易风险
risk_points_en: Fixed stop loss and take profit points do not adapt to varying instrument volatility — too wide for low-volatility and potentially insufficient for high-volatility instruments
No spread filter or maximum position check, which may cause significant losses during extreme market conditions
VWAP indicator depends on custom files; if missing, EA initialization will fail but won't pose trading risk
